title: Hosted model inference gateway
notes: Far-domain case (ticket 009 decision 6). The external entities are machines rather than people, the crown-jewel asset is a model artifact loaded as code rather than a record set, and two threat shapes have no analogue in the payments exemplar at all: artifact-integrity supply chain, and model-mediated disclosure across tenants. Also the only case where a store created for debugging (the inference log) is more sensitive than the system's nominal data.
